claim_scope: local explicit/implicit consistency under a fixed learned critic; not a return or causal actor-critic stability result
reference_actions: interior actions sampled from each offline dataset
critic_scale: C=mean absolute frozen Q1 over the sampled batch
expected_local_behavior: relative explicit/implicit discrepancy tends to zero. In smooth regions the absolute discrepancy is O(h^2); a ReLU critic is locally affine and can give exact agreement until a kink is crossed.
